description: PF7 backward over an EMPTY USRSEC - the one path that reaches READPREV's WHEN OTHER arm at :675-681, and the third leg of the STARTBR / READNEXT / READPREV outcome matrix gate G47 requires: STARTBR's OTHER is forced by case19, READNEXT's is reached by case10's HIGH-VALUES anchor, and READPREV's is reached only here. EIBCALEN is 194 and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1, so :115 takes the CDEMO-PGM-REENTER branch, :121 receives the map, and the inline EVALUATE EIBAID at :122-137 lands on WHEN DFHPF7 at :128-129. In PROCESS-PF7-KEY, CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST is 'ADMIN001' rather than spaces so :242 anchors SEC-USR-ID on it, :245 sets NEXT-PAGE-YES unconditionally, and the count of 2 satisfies :248, which performs PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD. There :338's STARTBR reports NOTFND because the file holds no record at or after the anchor, so the arm at :600-606 sets end of file, paints 'You are at the top of the page...' and sends the map - and note what that arm does NOT do: it raises NO error flag, which is precisely why :340 still admits the paragraph. :342's relation carries TWO operands, not the three of :288, so PF7 passes it and the READPREV at :343 is issued against a browse that was never established. It reports the open's own outcome, which is neither NORMAL nor ENDFILE, so the WHEN OTHER arm at :675-681 raises the error flag, paints 'Unable to lookup User...' and sends again. Every later guard then fails - :346 because end of file is set, :354's loop for the same reason, and :362 because both hold - so the descending fill never runs, no record is ever decoded, and the page arithmetic at :367 and :369 never executes. :374-:377 still run, because they sit inside the IF that opened at :340 and closes at :379: the page number is written to PAGENUMI from the count the payload supplied and the map is sent a third time. This is the backward mirror of case10. WHAT THIS CASE MAKES OBSERVABLE. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1 and DEPARTS 1: the only statements that zero it are :195 and :205, both inside the selection EVALUATE of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, and no ENTER path runs here - so the pass-through is asserted rather than assumed, and it is the exact contrast with the selection cases case13 and case14, where the context arrives 1 and departs 0 because the XCTL arm does run. Nothing is written and nothing is transferred, so nextProgram is null and termination is RETURN_TRANSID for the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CU00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :141-144; gate G40 is met here by the ABSENCE of a next target, the four XCTL targets themselves being pinned by case01 (COSGN00C), case11 (COADM01C), case13 (COUSR02C) and case14 (COUSR03C). CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM passes through as 2 unchanged, which is gate G28 read negatively: not one of the program's ADD, SUBTRACT or COMPUTE sites fires on this path. CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST and -LAST are unchanged because POPULATE-USER-DATA at :384 is never reached, and CDEMO-CU00-NEXT-PAGE-FLG is 'Y' from :245's unconditional SET. Gate G30 is satisfied by landing on the LAST arm of a three-arm EVALUATE whose WHEN OTHER is last, having passed NORMAL and ENDFILE in source order. TWO PUBLISHED-SURFACE GAPS, DECLARED RATHER THAN OMITTED (practice B12). First, the COBOL performs THREE SEND-USRLST-SCREENs on this path - at :606, at :681 and at :377 - but 'sends' pins ONE, because UserMenuController's published handler exposes only the transmission the terminal is left displaying and UserMenuControllerTest.onlyTheRequestMappingIsPublic pins the deliberate property that exactly one method beyond the constructors is public. The two earlier transmissions are asserted in the user package, where the work area is visible. WS-MESSAGE is not cleared between sends, which is why the surviving image carries the READPREV text rather than the STARTBR text. Second, expectedMessages is EMPTY although :676's DISPLAY 'RESP:' WS-RESP-CD 'REAS:' WS-REAS-CD does execute: that line is recorded on the work area and logged, but it is not part of the published outcome, so it too is asserted in the user package under gates G49 and G50 rather than on the DISPLAY_LINE channel here. Both are recorded as gaps rather than smoothed over. WIDTHS, SUMMED MECHANICALLY FROM THE COPYBOOKS (practice B11). app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 gives SEC-USR-ID 8 + SEC-USR-FNAME 20 + SEC-USR-LNAME 20 + SEC-USR-PWD 8 + SEC-USR-TYPE 1 = 57, and the NAMED SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) - a named field, not an anonymous FILLER - carries that to 80, which app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl fixes independently at :48 with DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) and at :64-66 with IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER KEYS(8,0) RECORDSIZE(80,80). Gates G19 and G21 are therefore asserted here through expectedDatasets.recordLength rather than through a decoded row: the dataset is declared EMPTY, so it has no row whose spans could be pinned, and the width together with a count of zero is the strongest statement available - which is exactly why the 'empty' shape is required to carry a recordLength and a copybook at all. A WRITES-channel expectation was evaluated and deliberately NOT declared: USRSEC is opened for browse and never as an output, so the fingerprint carries no WRITES channel for it and such an expectation would assert something the path cannot produce. app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 sums to 160 and the CDEMO-CU00-INFO extension at app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:67-75 sums to 8+8+8+1+1+8 = 34, so 160 + 34 = 194 is the declared EIBCALEN; COTRN00C's equivalent extension is 58 and is deliberately not copied. The 59 screen fields are pinned at the widths of the xxxI items of app/cpy-bms/COUSR00.CPY - ERRMSGO at its declared 78 and not at WS-MESSAGE's 80, the two lost bytes being the whole reason those are separate widths. CONVENTIONS AND CONSTRAINTS. normalisations is EMPTY, and correctly so: the 57-to-80 pad exists for seeded rows and this dataset seeds none, which is the property COUSR00CParityTest.theFiftySevenToEightyPadIsDeclaredWhereverRowsAreSeeded checks in both directions. jobParameters is omitted because ParityCase refuses a job parameter for any unitKind but BATCH_JOB; the conversation scalars travel as screenRequest.eibcalen, .aid and .commarea instead, which is also how gate G37 and rule R6 are met - the received screen, the attention identifier and the whole 194-byte context are in the payload, and there is no server-side session state anywhere in the path. The code page is named US-ASCII explicitly and never defaulted, and a space is kept distinct from LOW-VALUES (practice B8). The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:34, the source's own version stamp at :694, because POPULATE-HEADER-INFO reads FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at :564 on every send (practice B7). USRSEC is addressed by its binding key throughout and never by a dataset name (gate G46). The unit is the controller as a plain object, with no HTTP layer and no JobLauncher in the path (gate G51). Page size ten is behaviour and not configuration (gate G39): it is hard-coded at :293, :300, :347 and :352 and by 02 USER-REC OCCURS 10 TIMES at :57, and no page-size value appears in this file. Gate G38's REENTER side is driven here, and COUSR00C does NOT copy CSSETATY - its COPY list is exactly COCOM01Y, COUSR00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA at :66-84 - so there is no runtime DFHRED and no '*' overwrite to expect, ERRMSG being statically COLOR=RED at app/bms/COUSR00.bms:449-452. Gates G32, G35 and G43 do not apply and nothing is fabricated for them: the program contains no GO TO, no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC, and expectedReturnCode is 0 as it is for all twenty cases. Behaviour is preserved as found (practice B5): ENDBR at :687-691 specifies no RESP and has no EVALUATE after it, so no outcome is checked or expected; the dead WS-USER-DATA array at :56-64 stays unmodelled; and rule R1 stands - the plan mandates the class name UserMenuController while app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:5 reads 'List all users from USRSEC file' and README.md records CU00 as List Users, so the name comes from the plan and the behaviour from the source. PROVENANCE (practice B12, risk R-A). Every expected value here was DERIVED BY STRUCTURED READING of app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl and its copybooks and was NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy program. Executing it is impossible in this environment, which has no z/OS or CICS runtime, whose available COBOL compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, and which is missing the IBM-supplied DFHAID and DFHBMSCA this program copies at :83-84. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases per program, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-of-zero gate are all preserved (AAP 0.7.6 and 0.9.11). The derivation rests on :98-144, :237-255, :336-379, :562-581, :586-614 and :653-682 of the program; app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23; app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44; app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:67-75; app/cpy-bms/COUSR00.CPY; app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:48 and :64-66; and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:88-99, which defines FILE(USRSEC) with ADD, BROWSE, DELETE, READ and UPDATE - of which this program uses browse alone.
